text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Thanks for the letter! I can't believe that silly picture from the Hanshin J.F. blew up like that either!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: People around town have been calling me Snow Angel too… I guess that's what they called me on TV? Not gonna lie, all the hubbub's put my nerves on edge!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But this burst of popularity could be my chance! It's nice being called cute, but I'm gonna do my best so people think I'm the cat's pajamas too!
